title: Fee Schedule: After-Accession Cancellation Handling Fee and Duplicate-Test Window by Service Class
content:
Two class-level charge settings of Laboratory Test Orders are listed here: the class's cancellation handling fee after accessioning, and the duplicate-test window.

| Service class | Cancellation handling fee after accessioning (USD) | Duplicate-test window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | 0.00 | 1 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | 0.00 | 1 |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | 25.00 | 7 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | 0.00 | 1 |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | 15.00 | 1 |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | 35.00 | 0 |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | 150.00 | 365 |

## Definitions

**Cancellation handling fee after accessioning.** The class's specimen handling fee for a patient cancellation made after the specimen has been accessioned. A figure of 0.00 means the class has no such fee.

**Duplicate-test window.** The calendar days within which a second charge of the same test for the same patient on another order is treated as a duplicate and credited. A window of 0 means the class never treats a repeat as a duplicate.

## Notes

- Four classes carry a handling fee: Clinical Toxicology Testing (15.00), Esoteric Reference Testing (25.00), Anatomic Pathology & Cytology (35.00) and Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing (150.00).
- The duplicate-test windows run from 0 days (Anatomic Pathology & Cytology) to 365 days (Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing).
